purpose: Original app artwork based on user-provided room-mood and painterly-cat references.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: background scene for a cozy cat focus app. Transform the mood of the first reference into a NEW original hand-painted watercolor and gouache reading nook, using the soft painterly paper texture and natural detail of the second cat illustration as the art-direction reference. NO CAT IN THIS IMAGE: the character will be layered in separately. Warm ivory plaster, a soft cream boucle armchair in the center facing slightly left, small striped linen cushion at its back and an oatmeal knitted throw draped over the right arm, walnut bookcase at far left with muted book spines, leafy olive-like indoor plant behind the chair, elegant curved bronze floor lamp from the right with a glowing amber linen shade, a soft sheer curtain at the right edge. One small original abstract botanical print on the wall, no writing. An oval pale-wood coffee table kept low in the foreground on the right edge with a ceramic tea cup and a small glowing candle, a textured ivory rug. Quiet evening lamplight, subdued warm beige, walnut, mushroom, moss, caramel and rust colors. Detailed editorial gouache illustration with tactile brush strokes and soft pencil edges; no hard vector lines and no 3D render. Composition: landscape 4:3, the armchair dominates the center. Keep the CENTRAL CHAIR SEAT clear and exposed around x=52%, y=66% of the image, with enough flat cushion area to place a lying cat there. Keep foreground table away from the chair seat. Entire scene full-bleed, no border, no typography, no watermark, no UI elements. A calm lived-in literary sanctuary, tasteful and warm, with the elegant intimate feeling of the room reference rather than a cartoon playroom.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent cat character for a cozy Android focus app. Use the attached cat as a visual style reference, not a cutout target. Paint a NEW original brown mackerel tabby cat, with lovely soft sage-green eyes, cream muzzle and chest, dusty rose nose and inner ears, charcoal brown stripes. Natural feline proportions, lying comfortably with front paws tucked forward and tail curled along its body, head turned toward the viewer, gentle quiet expression. Warm hand-painted watercolor and opaque gouache on paper, delicate visible irregular brushwork and colored-pencil edges, subtle soft fur texture, sophisticated vintage picture-book illustration like the reference. Full body in a wide horizontal composition with ample transparent padding, viewed very slightly from above as if resting on an armchair cushion. Isolated character only on genuine transparent background. No chair, no room, no ground plane, no shadow rectangle, no text or logo. Preserve painterly texture and organic detail; avoid vector outlines, flat cartoon style, chibi proportions, glossy 3D, or photorealism. The cat should fill about 85 percent of the width, and be clearly readable at small mobile size.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this generated painterly tabby character for the focusing/sleeping state of a cozy app. Preserve the exact cat, body position, proportions, markings, warm watercolor/gouache brush texture, cream muzzle and paws, tail position, horizontal composition and genuine transparent background. Change ONLY the expression: close both eyes gently in a peaceful natural sleeping expression. The eyelids should be soft dark curved strokes with no visible eyeballs. Relax the ears very slightly if needed but keep the silhouette and position aligned with the original, so switching between the two images feels like the same cat calmly closing its eyes. Do not add background, chair, text, z letters, effects, borders, white fringe, or other objects.

Use case: logo-brand. Create the Android app icon for this original cozy focus app, using the attached generated watercolor tabby as the character reference. Square composition. Warm cream/oatmeal plain background with very subtle paper texture. A close portrait of the same natural brown striped tabby, green eyes, cream muzzle and rosy nose, showing head, ears, chest and tucked front paws. Painterly watercolor/gouache brushwork and colored-pencil edges must match the reference. Center the face with generous breathing room so Android's circular/adaptive mask cannot cut the ears. Keep all important facial details within the middle 65% of the square. Soft amber evening light, muted walnut and beige tones. The cat feels quiet and affectionate. No lettering, no name, no UI, no rounded-corner outline, no badges, no border, no watermark, no flat vector cartoon look. Fill the whole canvas with the warm ivory background.
